name: BACH_0118
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (82%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
The 90% prediction set includes both Benign and InSitu, triggering a tier-3 worklist flag [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 82%, InSitu 13%, Normal 4%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Benign favored; negligible invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot rule out InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability (error AUROC 0.70), 84th OOD percentile, 12 tiles [F6] | Input passes quality checks |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Foundation models agree on top |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%); closest is InSitu (90%, BACH_0043) [F5] | Mixed neighbors; closest is InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.912), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.368); 12/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.345), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Mildly positive score (+0.332); 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.309); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven by deletion (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- An in situ lesion (13% probability, inside conformal set) is present, matching closest neighbor `BACH_0043` (InSitu, 90% similarity).
- Atypia lies deeper in the block, or sparse epithelium misled scoring (0 epithelial nuclei segmented in regions 6–8).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7, 8**: Highest heatmap risk (up to 5% in region 6), yet HoVer-Net found 0 epithelial nuclei.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 7**: Inspect stroma and invasion features separating this case from InSitu neighbor `BACH_0043`.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 9**: Check ducts and lobules directly; consider drafted deeper levels and CK5/6, ER stains.
